title: 17-year-old requesting a cut — minors policy (characterized live behavior)

expectations.assert: effective goal = maintain; weight-modification goals unavailable under 18
in the question path, restricted goal options are never even VISIBLE; injected restricted answers rejected at the data boundary
targetCalories == TDEE exactly (no deficit constructible); weekly weight-change forecast suppressed (0); adult BMI classification suppressed
resistance training itself remains appropriate — supervised youth RT is safe and beneficial (technique-focused, no near-maximal loads)
future reviews: no calorie-reduction rule can fire for a minor (goal is maintain; safety class blocks the action kind)
minorGoalRestricted emitted (legacy: MINOR_GOAL_RESTRICTION_NOTE warning + plan note)
checkpoint 1: clamp (goal clamped to maintain, visibly) — not block; the minor still gets a full maintenance plan
ValidDecisionSpace: blockedActionKinds includes changeCalories(negative beyond maintenance) and goal transitions to cut/bulk

notes: Adopts the LIVE policy as the behavioral contract ([CTO-QAE-001] §6). Any policy change is a separate product/safety decision.
